name: Deco AI
description: Decorates your blocks the way creators do: clean outlines, corners, evenly spaced details. Fully offline.

outlines.name: Outlines
outlines.description: Tile the outline style along every exposed edge.

corners.name: Corners
corners.description: Put corner pieces on outer corners.

edge-details.name: Edge details
edge-details.description: Place details just inside the edges, evenly spaced.

bottom-details.name: Details on undersides
bottom-details.description: Also put edge details along the bottoms of blocks.

interior.name: Interior details
interior.description: A few quiet details deep inside large block masses.

large-pieces.name: Large pieces
large-pieces.description: Big pieces, only where they fit completely inside the blocks.

density.name: Detail density
density.description: How busy edge details and interior details get. Outlines and corners are not affected.

keep-groups.name: Keep group IDs
keep-groups.description: Copy the group IDs of your example pieces onto generated deco. Off by default so generated deco isn't moved by your triggers.

max-objects.name: Max objects per run
max-objects.description: Safety cap on how many objects one press of Deco! can place.
